title: Meridian
metaDescription: 1.56ct Fancy Intense Yellow Round Brilliant pendant — sunburst baguette halo in total symmetry. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: This exceptional pendant centers a fancy intense yellow round brilliant diamond, set in yellow gold prongs and encircled by a close-set halo of colorless round diamonds. Radiating outward, a full ring of tapered baguette-cut diamonds arranged in a sunburst pattern amplifies the center stone's warmth. An outer border of round brilliants completes the composition in total symmetry.

specs.label: Center Stone
specs.body: 1.56 carats · Round Brilliant cut · Fancy Intense Yellow.

specs.label: Baguette Sunburst
specs.body: 32 tapered baguette-cut diamonds · 0.87 carats total · arranged in a full sunburst ring radiating from the center stone.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Pendant design · yellow gold prongs · close-set inner halo of colorless round brilliants · outer border of round brilliants completing the symmetrical composition.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Designed and made in Los Angeles. Available by private appointment. Custom sizing on request.
